validation_gates.rule: Every input value has an official or clearly labelled source URL. Unverified values are blank and flagged.
Each prediction uses only information available before kickoff (e.g., injury report as of the posting time).
Rules are set on one period (training) and scored on a later period (test) that was not used to choose them.
validation_gates.threshold: Test period never used for tuning

validation_gates.rule: Enough bets for the result to mean something before any ranking.
validation_gates.threshold: Proposed: at least 300 scored bets per strategy (user to confirm; SG-06)

validation_gates.rule: Average line taken must beat the closing line, measured in points for spreads.
validation_gates.threshold: Positive mean CLV with a stated confidence interval

validation_gates.rule: Return on stake after the standard -110 price is included. Break-even at -110 is 52.38% win rate (arithmetic: 110 / 210).
validation_gates.threshold: Lower bound of 95% confidence interval above zero

validation_gates.rule: Legs are only combined if their measured outcome correlation is within a stated limit; the independence assumption is tested, not assumed.
validation_gates.threshold: Correlation estimate reported with sample size

validation_gates.rule: When many strategies are tested, adjust p-values (e.g., Benjamini-Hochberg) so luck is not rewarded.
The result holds in more than one season or split, not just one period.
validation_gates.threshold: Positive in at least 2 of 3 splits (proposed)
